reviews.text: Great Fit, Great Shoe. Getting shoes offline has always been a gamble for me because I never know if they are going to fit like I want them to. Shoes fit me either too tight or too loose depending on the size and type of shoe. I was totally happy to get these though and see that they are a great fit. I know these says mens shoe, but I really loved the design of them and wanted a good pair of running/walking shoe because I am trying to do that more and needed something with a bit more support than what I had. These feel great on the feet and the shoe itself is thin, lightweight, and totally breathable. These are huge in the summer time because it will help keep my feet all nice and cool while trying to get my walk on. These are super comfy, look great, and is everything I want in a good shoe. Very happy with these shoes

Tighten Laces for Proper Power-Walking Fit. Like any serious power-walking shoes, these NEW BALANCE WOMEN’S WALKING SHOES (669v1) require properly tightened laces to be comfortable. They’re designed for sports—for providing good, stable support for your feet during exercise—rather than for everyday casual wear. They’re different from leather walking shoes, and different from your usual inexpensive sneakers.

The shoes are quite stiff when you first put them on, but they soon begin to relax, so the “breaking in” period is minimal. I thought that mine were going to rub my ankles and cause blisters, until I adjusted the laces. Now they’re fine. They don’t have a lot of cushioning, so I wouldn’t recommend them for anyone who has to stand for long stretches.

The shoes are two shades of gray, with a rose-gold “N” logo. The logo only appears to be gold when the light hits it right, and it sometimes it appears to be silver. The shoes are well-made, and the size 8B fits pretty much as expected. The length is right for my size 8 foot; the toe box is a little wider than my other 8M shoes

reviews.text:
LEATHER LINING & UPPERS-Perfect Summer Sandals These Are WINNERS!. Our daughter has been used to buying Borne or Sofft shoes. She needed a new pair of sandals, so we got her these. Let's see how they measure up.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
First of all, these shoes are one of the few shoes left that has LEATHER LINED LEATHER UPPERS. That is important for people like me and my daughter who have problems with faux leather tearing up our feet in the summer time, leaving rough raw skin. The sole where the foot rests is also leather so there is not any sliding when the feet sweat.

The closure is velcro, and they close at the ankle. There is a buckle at the ankle to control the tightness somewhat. The front strap and the center strap are a very dark brown. The rest of the straps are a gorgeous dark hematite color. The buckles reflect the dark brown but they are metallic and look very classy. The sole is EXTREMELY grippy.

These shoes come in a nice box with each shoe in its own bag which is a nice classy touch.

HOW DO THESE SANDALS PERFORM?
I have to say that our daughter has a tough time with shoes. These fit her perfectly and she LOVES them. She wears them all of the time and marvels at how they do not slip and she can walk just about anywhere without issue. The fit is very roomy and her feet tend toward the wide direction. Her ankles are also rather thick, and these fit perfectly as well.

TRUE TO SIZE?
These run very true to size- if you tend toward wider feet, there should not be any problem. VERY narrow feet might not like these.

THE BOTTOM LINE
With true to size fit and excellent leather linings and outer shell, these sandals are a hit with our daughter. She loves them, enjoys how grippy they are on the sole, and the color is very unique and goes with a lot.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS! These are a winner. I would definitely be open to buying a pair of these for myself

The bottom is dense and durable. No worries about kids biting through them (I had shockingly had this happen multiple times with other flip flops) or them tearing up quickly. If you do have a problem, contact Reef and they will help you out. They want you to be happy with their shoes. These do have flat bottoms. reviews.text:
Once you've had a pair, you'll never be without them!. I have worn these for years. They actually give me more support and comfort than my expensive tennis shoes!! I love them. I can wash them in the washer and dry them in the dryer. They come out just perfect. I would recommend these to women every where. Once you've had a pair, you want ever be without one.
Susan Mejia

Solid run around town- active shoe!. Purchased these for a fun trendy shoe to transition out of winter and into spring... love the color combo- mostly monochromatic gray they will match plenty… The mint green is so subtle yet, fun! I like the idea of easy on/off- although, these have laces… If tied loose, one can slide foot in and out easy enough without untying each time!

Fit was solid in the length but, a bit wider through the top toe section.. giving me an extra bend and crease in material- not my favorite as, I feel like I have clown feet but, husband promises they look completely normal?! Not enough to be a dealbreaker but, something to keep in mind if you have a narrow foot.

These are very light weight and by light, I mean it feel like almost nothing on the foot!! As a dancer for 20 years I have flat feet! So, a high arch support something I’m not used too.. I can only wear for a few hours at a time. Hoping this gets better as my foot adapts... for those who don’t appreciate arch support- keep this in mind.

Lastly, the tongue Is stitched in such a way.. that these don’t have a lot of movement for repositioning. Most the structure comes from tying the lace- another caveat a lot of running shoes are going to but, it may take a bit getting used to.

Overall, for the price point of $36… They are solid shoe. Not something that would be used for a rigorous workouts but, more conducive to being active and run around town shoes! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

took a bit to break them in. great sneaker!...just a bit small...but I made it work.
A good walking shoe, maybe not 'stylish' but functional!
will buy again if they still make them when I need them
Cute. These are cute and my 11 yr old likes them a lot. She has been wanting a pair of platform sneakers. She says they are comfortable. They are a good dupe for real converse

true to size, fits my wide feet with high arches, comfortable, slimming looking. Please dont boost the price, as much of the appeal has to do with the budget friendly pricing of being no more than $22. These are cute shoes. I have the black with the pink/purple design. I usually go with safe colors (goes with everything) as I dont want to spend money on all sorts of different colors. With these, I am very likely to buy all the colors.

The shoes do not look cheap to me. They have a neat upper solid mesh texture, have a solid bottom with grip, the interior has a padded insole. And shocker of shock, they FIT. I have the size 11. I have size 10/10.5 feet. I have WIDE feet (hereditary bunions on both feet, both sides), and when I can't find wide width, I can sometimes get away with a larger length because the width is just enough to accommodate. Usually this only works with sneakers. I really had no idea how it would be with a pair of casual shoes. Vine stuff isn't free exactly, so I was truly taking a chance on these. I think someone in a review mentioned fitting wide, and that is what pushed me over the edge wanting to try these-- and be able to report back my findings.

They fit. They fit!! Funny, they do not look like they would. They are slim looking. But they slid right on, and didn't strangle my feet. They have a little flexibility. Like, they are structured but have some give. And yet my feet dont look like they are over flowing. My feet look slender in these. SO crazy.

So.. as for true to size. I think they are. Like I said, I wear a size 10.5, so often go with an 11. These 11's do not feel too long. The width is perfect for my wide feet, but I think that has more to do with the slight give more than a wide design. The other aspect to a shoe fit in the spacing between top and bottom. They fit well here too-- my feet arent bulging out the top. Perhaps those with very narrow, petite in all directions may find these loose. I do not know. Shoes are often geared toward more petite feet, so my enthusiasm is that they fit my larger, wider, thicker feet at the size I normally get. I really do hope this paragraph helps explain them to you.

I would say if anything, since they are a flat, low profile, slim, thin, ballet style shoe, that if you have super high arches like I do, then you will feel /see a little bit of your arch. But the shoe stays on.. so no complaints. I would love to seem more colors and designs. This is the first time I want to buy cute shoes. Keep it at the $20 price point, and I think those who buy one pair and like them will also come back for more

5 stars because.... I have severe condromalacia patella, and my knees are always bothering me. Shockingly, since Ive been walking/running in these sneakers, my knee pain is non-existent. I am now a Brooks believer! Also I get complimented on them CONSTANTLY, so there's that LOL

Perfect for Spinning or Road Riding. This is a good set that includes both pedals and shoes. The shoes have three Velcro straps and are well ventilated. I am usually a size 10.5, but I ordered a size 11 and they fit perfectly. Cycling shoes almost always run a half size smaller than walking shoes.

The pedals are good quality. They have an SPD style pedal on one side and a platform pedal on the other side. The cleats are also included. These pedals allow you to ride with your shoes clipped in, or you can ride on the flat side like a regular bicycle.

These are nice pedals for an exercise bicycle that has multiple users. Riders without SPD cleats can use the flat side of the pedal. You can adjust the tension on the pedals with an included Allen wrench.

The shoes are comfortable with a stiff sole. These are attractive, practical, and durable shoes that will allow you to get more out of your cycling workouts

Great Style and Comfort. I have been working to expand my shoe options over the past few years. There was a time when I purchased one or two pairs of white sneakers and that was all I had. I wore them until they wore out and then replaced them. Today, I have more pairs of shoes and more colors and one of the better shoes I have added to my collection is these Duoro Men’s Running Shoes.

These shoes feature an attractive pattern of small, white lines contrasting against the black background. The bottom of the shoes is rubberized and grips well. The black laces are already in place and ready to tie, straight from the package. The back of the shoes are low enough that they don’t rub against the back of your foot when you walk or do exercise.

I normally wear a size 11 when I purchase shoes, but I decided to go with 11.5 with these shoes and I am glad I did! That extra half- size makes all the difference. The shoes are quite comfortable for an extended walk because there is enough room that I don’t ever feel the sensation of tightness, even after walking for several hours. And with the grip from the soles, I can feel confident that I won’t slip.

I like having more shoe options to fit different occasions. These black running shoes from Duoro are one of the best I have purchased thus far. They look great, feel great, and will satisfy many of my walking and fitness needs in the coming years

Great Zero Drop Running Shoes. Minimalist running shoes are a great way to change up your running workouts. These shoes are so lightweight that it almost feels like you are running barefoot, but they offer very good protection for the soles of your feet. The shoes are made from a breathable mesh with a large toe box. The rubber from the sole extends up over the toe to provide protection from roots and stones.

The shoe has an elastic lace with a pinch slider. The lace has a Velcro tab on one end so you can attach it to the shoe and keep it from getting caught on grass or twigs. The insert has a surprising amount of padding, and the tread is non-slip and good for wet or dry terrain.

These are a great pair of shoes for trail workouts, or for slipping on after a marathon to give your feet a break. They're comfortable, dry quickly, and fit like a glove. If you are a person who is usually between half-sizes, I would recommend selecting the larger size here

A Little Snug, but Otherwise Nice. I have been gradually expanding my shoe options and the type of shoe I wear more than any other are sneakers. It’s always good to have a variety of sneakers handy for different needs and this is what convinced me to get these ZASEPY Men's Waterproof Hiking Shoes.

These shoes have a reasonably stylish look to them and the soles help grip surfaces so you can feel safe as you walk. I do take occasional hikes but I have separate shoes for that purpose and I don’t know if I would use these for hiking, even though the manufacturer claims they can be used for that purpose. For me, these shoes are best for day-to-day walking and since they are black in color, they match better with certain components of my wardrobe.

The laces on these shoes are a little shorter than expected, making it more challenging to double knot them, which is how I usually tie my shoes. I can always replace them with longer laces, so this is no biggie. I also noticed that these shoes are slightly more elevated than others I own. I could feel the difference when I put them on for the first time- I definitely felt slightly taller than usual.

The greatest issue I have with these shoes is that they are a little tighter than expected. I notice that most everyone who has left a review has said the same thing. I wear a size 11, but 11.5 or 12 would have been better. To be fair, they did feel better after wearing them several times and breaking them in. The first time I wore them, I kept slipping them off due to the tight, uncomfortable fit. Now, they feel a little better, but I still wish I had selected a slightly larger size.

I own more shoes now than at any time in my life and these shoes from ZASEPY are proving a good addition to my expanding shoe rack. Just be sure to order a larger size than usual and you should be fine

I love my J&M shoes, but the quality is not what it used to be.... I have owned Johnston & Murphy shoes in the past, so I was very comfortable with ordering over the internet. These shoes are high quality and will last years. My last pair lasted 5 years with 2 re-soles. My Bostonian shoes are completely worn out after two years. I am disappointed with the J&M Oxfords because the insole has started to lift out of the shoe. Insoles should not lift after wearing the shoes 6 or 7 times, or even 600 times. It is just poor quality workmanship during the glue process. I decided not to send the shoes back, because I really like them a lot. Shoe rating would be a 5 without the insole issue. I will take them to a local shoemaker to have the insoles glued in properly. If there is additional info, I will update this post.

Details of why I like these shoes:
- leather soles that have a decent life
- all leather shoes that wear very well
- the quality of the workmanship cut & sew is good
- the shoes are perfectly matched, unlike many of the shoes you find today
- solid shoe with enough flexibility for a lot of walking

Well Crafted. Wow, these shoes are really beautiful. I never thought I would say that about a pair of sneakers, but there it is. I am so impressed by the level of quality and craftsmanship that went into these shoes. It's the small details, like the smoothness of the seams, how the pieces all fit together so nicely, and the obvious quality of the materials. The outer leather has a nice firmness to it for support, and the inner lining is gorgeous, soft leather that feels cushy and comfortable. I wore them to a workout, and they were very comfortable. My only issue is that they seem a bit narrow, but of course, I have large feet. I am a woman, and I can usually wear a men's size 9 quite comfortable. These pinched a bit in the width, but as these shoes are leather, I expect that they will stretch with use and eventually feel a bit more roomy. I am going to keep wearing them to my workouts, as I feel this is a minor issue
